<style type="text/css">
        .bookInfo {
            position: relative;
            opacity: 1.0;
            padding-top: 1.0em;
            background-color: white;
            text-align: center;
            text-decoration-color: Background;
            font-weight: bold;

<script charset="utf-8" type="text/javascript">

        resizeInfoDiv = function () {
            var parent = $("#infoCheck");
            var child = $('.bookInfo');
            child.height(parent.height() / 10).width(parent.width()).css("top", parent.height() / 3);
        };

        startInfoDiv = function (count) {
            $(".bbloadernone").css("visibility", "hidden");

            bbcore.infoPermanentGray();

            var countText = "";
            if (count != null) {
                $(".bbloadernone").css("visibility", "visible");
                countText = "Versuch: " + count + " von max. 5."
            }

            $("#infoCheck").html("");
            $("#infoCheck").append("<div class='bookInfo'>Ihre Buchung wird ausgeführt! " + countText + " Bitte haben Sie etwas Geduld.</div>");

            resizeInfoDiv();
        };

        checkVorgang = function () {
            var ret = false;
            var urlReq = '/';
            var blacklist = ["admin", "response", "transaction", "finish"];
            $.each(blacklist, function (i, v) {
                if (urlReq.toLowerCase().indexOf(v) >= 0)
                    ret = true;
            });
            if (ret == true)
                return;

            $(window).resize(function () {
                resizeInfoDiv();
            });

            startInfoDiv();

            $.get('/Shop/CheckVorgang', {
            },
            function (data) {
            }).success(function (response) {

                if (response.vorgang != null && response.vorgang > 0) {
                    var counter = response.versuche + 1;

                    startInfoDiv(counter);

                    if (response.versuche >= 1) {
                        var param = response.vorgang;
                        var url = '/Cart/Finish/__param__';
                        window.location.href = url.replace('__param__', encodeURIComponent(param));
                    }

                }
            }).error(function (response) {
            });

            bbcore.infoEnd();

            return true;
        };

        $(document).ready(function () {

            checkVorgang();
            bbcore.infoEnd();

            var bez = 'Ticketfritz';
            var tids = 'UA-29179658-46';

            var test = $.cookieBar();
            $('#cookie-bar .cb-enable').click(function (ele) {

                bbcore.googleGaOptin(tids, bez, true);

                $("#ga-activate-btn").click(function () {
                    bbcore.googleGaOptin(tids, bez, true);
                });

                return true;
            });
            $('#cookie-bar .cb-policy').click(function (ele) {
                $.cookieBar("set", "accepted");
                $('#cookie-bar').hide(0, function () { $('#cookie-bar').remove() });
                bbcore.showMainModal();

                return true;
            });

            
            
            $("a[rel^='prettyPhoto']").prettyPhoto();
            

            var globalTimeout = null;
            var current = null;
            var HostWithPort = 'https://ticketfritz.de';
            $('#Suche').keyup(function () {
                if (globalTimeout != null) {
                    clearTimeout(globalTimeout);
                }
                current = $(this);
                globalTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    globalTimeout = null;

                    var Language = "de-DE";
                    var SelLanguage = 'de-DE';
                    if (SelLanguage != null && SelLanguage != "") {
                        Language = SelLanguage;
                    }
                    bbcore.searchContent(HostWithPort, Language, current.val(), 'Leider keine Ergebnisse gefunden');
                }, 300);
            });
        });
    </script>

<script type="text/javascript">

    $(document).ready(function () {

        

        var gaactive = bbcore.checkUAIsActive();
        if (gaactive == true)
        {
            $("#ga_status").text("active");
            $(".ga-deactivate").show();
        }
        else
        {
            $("#ga_status").text("inactive");
            $(".ga-activate").show();
        }

        $(".close").click(function () {
            $("#MainModalDiv").hide();
        });


        $('#cookie-accordion').find('.accordion-toggle').click(function () {
            $(this).next().slideToggle('fast');
            $(".accordion-content").not($(this).next()).slideUp('fast');
        });



    });


    var bez = 'Ticketfritz';
    var tids = 'UA-29179658-46';
    $("#ga-activate-btn").click(function () {
        bbcore.googleGaOptin(tids, bez, true);
    });
    $("#ga-deactivate-btn").click(function () {
        bbcore.googleGaOptout(tids, bez, true);
    });

    

    $("#modal-close").click(function () {
        $("#MainModalDiv").hide();
    });
</script>

<p style="text-align: left;"><strong>In unserem neuen Online-Shop zeigen wir Ihnen an Beispielen, wie Kaufinteressenten zukünftig in Ihrem Online-Shop Eintrittskarten, Führungen, Veranstaltungen und auch Shop-Artikel bequem online buchen bzw. kaufen können.</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Das TOP-Modul Online-Shop ermöglicht den Verkauf über das Internet bzw. über mobile Endgeräte. Durch die Programmierung im "Responsive Design" wird gewährleistet, dass sich die Darstellung des Online-Shops am jeweiligen Endgerät orientiert, unabhängig davon, ob man den Shop über einen herkömmlichen PC, über ein Tablet oder ein Smartphone betrachtet.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Sollten Sie Fragen zur Funktionsweise oder auch generell zu Online-Shop haben, stehen wir Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung unter 040/399 202-0 oder per Mail unter <a href="mailto:dtp@beckerbillett.de">dtp@beckerbillett.de</a>.</p>

<script src="/Scripts/textresizedetector.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">

    function init() {
        var iBase = TextResizeDetector.addEventListener(onFontResize, null);
    }

    function onFontResize(e, args) {
        setTileHeight();
    }

    TextResizeDetector.TARGET_ELEMENT_ID = 'start-promotion';
    TextResizeDetector.USER_INIT_FUNC = init;

    setTileHeight = function () {
        var imgHeight = 200;
        var capHeight = 100;
        var copyrightHeight = 0;
        
        var maxheight = 0;

        $(".promotion-media-object").each(function () {
            var intimgHeight = parseInt(imgHeight);
            var intCurrHeight = parseInt($(this).css("height").match(/\d+/));
            if (intimgHeight < intCurrHeight)
                imgHeight = intCurrHeight;
        });

        $(".image-copyright").each(function () {
            var currItemHeight = $(this).css("height").match(/\d+/);
            if (copyrightHeight < currItemHeight)
                copyrightHeight = currItemHeight;
        });

        $(".promotion-caption").each(function () {
            var curItemHeight = $(this).css("height").match(/\d+/);
            if (capHeight < curItemHeight)
                capHeight = curItemHeight;
        });

        
        maxheight = parseInt(imgHeight) + parseInt(capHeight) + parseInt(copyrightHeight) - 10;

        $(".promotion-thumbnail").each(function () {
            $(this).css("height", "" + maxheight + "px");
        });
        $(".promotion-kachel").each(function () {
            $(this).css("height", "" + maxheight + "px");
        });

        $(".promotion-caption").css("display", "block");
        $(".promotion-caption").each(function () {
            $(this).css("width", "100%");
            $(this).css("position", "absolute");
            $(this).css("bottom", "0px");
        });
    };

    $(window).resize(function () {
        setTileHeight();
    });

    $(document).ready(function () {
        var StartseitePromotionIntegrated = 'False';
        if (StartseitePromotionIntegrated != "True")
        {
            setTimeout(function () {
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'POST',
                    async: true,
                    url: '/Home/Promotion',
                    contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function (result) {
                        if (result.success == true) {
                            $("#start-promotion").append(result.PRContent);
                            setTimeout(function () {
                                setTileHeight();
                            }, 800);
                        }
                        else {}
                    }
                });
                bbcore.loaderEndPermanent();
            }, 300);
        }
        else
        {
            setTileHeight();
            bbcore.loaderEndPermanent();
        }
    });
</script>
